evidence.detail: The sole static behavior takes one item-name String and recognizes a large exact set of mystery/reward containers including Donator mystery box, Blood key, Grand blood key, PvP mystery box, Bond casket key, Easter/H'ween/Summer/Winter caskets and multiple package/chest variants.

For every recognized container the class appends exact reward/rarity/seasonal description text and builds a representative int[] of reward item IDs; unrecognized names leave the payload null and return false.

On a recognized item the class derives coordinates from live mouse state, invokes Client.a(int,int,String,int[]), and that exact Client method constructs R207 TooltipContent, attaches the reward item IDs and submits it to R207 TooltipOverlay.
rs/r has no fields and no second behavior: it is a stateless specialized reward-preview producer for hover/tooltips rather than a container-opening or server-reward implementation.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the specialized mystery/casket/key/package reward preview producer. It does not claim an original stripped identifier or server reward authority.
